request: Replace the plain Box shortcut with a basic-pattern dropdown. Four-cycle means four independent Box 2x choices, left/right/left/right.
choices: 固定のダブルボックス
シャワー型のダブルボックス

definitions.fixedDouble: The existing Extended Box centre-column layout.
definitions.showerDouble: 4x travels in a Shower arc; 4 is vertical.
definitions.fourCycle: Four Box sets beginning with the performer's left 2x; each pass can be selected independently.

automated.coverage: All six recipes remain valid and identifiable after JSON serialization; fixed versus Shower Double high-flight definitions differ; four independent passes preserve hand order in Normal, Switched and alternating Cross; imported right-first cycles retain their start; source objects remain unchanged.

checks: Each of the six dropdown choices starts playback without errors.
Four-cycle Normal / Shuffle / Reverse Shuffle / Inverted plays and restores all four values after reload.
High-Low with right fixed high hand, right-over swap and Shuffle keeps the 6x-plus-2x / swap schedule and plays.
Shower with Normal Lateral remains Shower and plays.
The dropdown is disabled during model loading and motion generation, then re-enabled.
Four-cycle pass controls precede column controls; 390px-wide phones show two cards per row.
No horizontal overflow at 390x844 or 320x568; no console errors.
browser.limits: Browser viewport testing, not a physical phone.
